issue.title: Minimal *-deployment dependencies for integration-tests

labels.name: area/dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

labels.name: area/devtools
labels.description: Issues/PR related to maven, gradle, platform and cli tooling/plugins

issue.body:
Resolves #10859 (once finalized)

See also [discussion on zulip](https://quarkusio.zulipchat.com/#narrow/stream/187038-dev/topic/parallel.20build.20problem.20in.20integration-test-grpc-*) where we have already discussed a few approaches and details.

A violation looks like this:

```
[INFO] --- maven-enforcer-plugin:3.0.0-M3:enforce (enforce-deployment-deps) @ quarkus-integration-test-cache ---
[WARNING] Rule 0: io.quarkus.enforcer.RequiresMinimalDeploymentDependency failed with message:
The following *-deployment dependencies are missing/configured incorrectly:
    io.quarkus:quarkus-hibernate-orm-panache-deployment:999-SNAPSHOT
    io.quarkus:quarkus-jdbc-h2-deployment:999-SNAPSHOT
    io.quarkus:quarkus-resteasy-jsonb-deployment:999-SNAPSHOT
    io.quarkus:quarkus-smallrye-context-propagation-deployment:999-SNAPSHOT

Each of these dependencies has to be configured as follows to get a consistent build order:
    <dependency>
        <groupId>GROUP-IP</groupId>
        <artifactId>ARTIFACT-ID</artifactId>
        <version>${project.version}</version>
        <type>pom</type>
        <scope>test</scope>
        <exclusions>
            <exclusion>
                <groupId>*</groupId>
                <artifactId>*</artifactId>
            </exclusion>
        </exclusions>
    </dependency>
[INFO] ------------------------------------------------------------------------
[INFO] BUILD FAILURE
[INFO] ------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

This is WIP for now. General things I'd like to discuss:
- [x] Location under `devtools` yay or nay? Seemed to be the best choice. Alternative: `independent-projects`
- [x] General upgrade of enforcer-plugin from M2 to M3 yay or nay? Clear yay from me.
- [x] Should every required dep be printed fully in XML to copy it "blindly" to the pom without much effort?
- [x] Test coverage in the new module via [`maven-invoker-plugin`](https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-invoker-plugin/) yay or nay? I tend to yay.
- [x] ~We should consider using this rule also _outside_ of `integration-tests` (via a subsequent PR) to make the _entire_ reactor build order consistent, not just the test part. This would then also allow us to build incrementally, e.g. with [`gitflow-incremental-builder`](https://github.com/vackosar/gitflow-incremental-builder), which would cut down CI (and local) build times massively. For this we need to decide whether those "symbolic" dependencies would be problematic in case they show up in the "userspace".~
  Postponed! Will restart that discussion with another PR.

Obvious tasks left:
- [x] pom.xml cleanup
- [x] pull the rule up to `integration-tests` parent
- [x] add the now required deployment deps to each submodule (the "fun part") and switch level of rule from `WARN` to `ERROR`
- [x] drop "Symbolic" from the pom.xml comments & enrich rule with some javadoc

Any feedback is very much appreciated!
